|printed_lore=''<span lang="ja">ビス男性の傭兵。フィグリン・ダンのバンドの控えのクルー・ホーンのプレイヤーでもある。ドイック以外で唯一、楽器の所有権をフィグリンに奪われていないミュージシャンである。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
|translation='''Title:''' Lirin Car'n.

'''Card text:'''
If at the same location card as other musicians, Lirin may collect a “bodyguard fee.” For each musician there other than himself, add 1 to the cost for a character to deploy to or move to that location.

'''Lore:'''
A male Bith mercenary. He is also the backup Kloo Horn player in Figrin D'an's band. Besides Doikk, he is the only musician who has not lost ownership of his instrument to Figrin.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese cover charge is 用心棒代.
